in_marathi.name: Jaswant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jaswant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Jaswant is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘jas’ which means ‘desirable’ and ‘want’ which means ‘to wish’. The name is often given to a child as a symbol of the parents' hope and desire for their child's future happiness and success.
